one_line: Peshwa’s cousin and commander-in-chief of the Maratha army at the Third Battle of Panipat, 1761.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, tall and athletic with a commander’s bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline, wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard, intense dark eyes with thick brows; default expression calm but resolute, with a slight furrow of focus between the brows.
appearance.hair: Black hair gathered under a deep-red Maratha-style pagadi (turban) with layered folds, a small golden turra-like ornament pinned to the front left, and a thin off-white cloth band visible at the base.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-18th century Maratha noble-warrior attire: a long knee-length off-white cotton angarkha tied diagonally across the chest with narrow red piping at the edges, worn over a fitted pale-cream cotton paijama; a sleeveless quilted dark-indigo velvet-like coat (jacketed zabba) over the angarkha with subtle vertical stitching, a broad deep-red silk sash (patka) wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the left hip, and a second narrower mustard-yellow waist-belt over it for weapons; he wears soft mid-calf brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, simple gold stud earrings, a thin gold chain around the neck, and a rudraksha bead bracelet on his right wrist; during battle he has a plain steel round shield strapped across his back with leather straps.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Maratha talwar with a steel blade, a brass hilt with a disc pommel and knuckle-guard, and a dark-brown leather scabbard worn on his left side, partially tucked into the deep-red waist sash.

ref_desc: Sadashivrao Bhau is a tall, athletic Maratha commander with an oval wheatish face, short black beard and moustache, wearing a deep-red turban, off-white angarkha with dark-indigo sleeveless coat, red sash, brown mojari shoes and carrying a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sadashivrao Bhau as a mid-18th century Maratha commander: a tall, athletic man in his early 30s with an oval wheatish face, sharp jawline, straight nose, intense dark eyes, and neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard, his expression calm and resolute. His black hair is covered by a deep-red Maratha-style turban with layered folds and a small golden ornament pinned on the front left, with a thin off-white band at the base. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha tied diagonally across the chest with narrow red piping, over fitted pale-cream paijama trousers, and over this a sleeveless dark-indigo quilted coat with subtle vertical stitching. Around his waist is a broad deep-red silk sash wrapped twice and knotted at the left hip, with a narrower mustard-yellow belt over it holding his weapon. Show a slightly curved Maratha talwar with a steel blade, brass hilt and disc pommel in a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging on his left and partially tucked into the sash, and a plain round steel shield strapped across his back with leather straps. Add soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes, simple gold stud earrings, a thin gold chain at his neck, and a rudraksha bead bracelet on his right wrist. Use a palette dominated by deep red, off-white, dark indigo, mustard yellow, and brown leather, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show face, hair, full costume, and weapon details.
